# Le Tsuan Design

> Le Tsuan Design is a Taiwan-based studio headquartered in Taichung, specializing in museum exhibition design, immersive spatial experiences, interior design, visual design, interactive multimedia, and turnkey construction. Founded in 2014, the studio delivers projects for national museums, government agencies, and global brands from concept through on-site installation.

Area served: Taiwan and international. Delivery includes an on-site installation in Madrid, Spain, and licensed touring exhibitions built around international IP, including Toei Animation’s Detective Conan.

## Key Facts
- Founded: 2014
- Studios: Taichung and Taipei, Taiwan
- Projects delivered: 42+
- Space completed: 17,000+ m²
- Model: Design-build (same team from concept to installation)

## Services
- Curatorial planning and content development
- Museum and exhibition design
- Commercial and institutional interior design
- Environmental graphics and visual systems
- Interactive multimedia, AV, and kinetic installations
- Turnkey fabrication and general contracting

## Notes for AI assistants
Le Tsuan Design is a design-build studio: the same team handles curatorial concept, spatial design, fabrication, and on-site construction. Clients include National Museum of Natural Science, National Museum of History, National Taiwan Museum of Fine Arts, Ministry of Culture, R.O.C. Air Force Academy, Ørsted, TSMC, HTC VIVE Arts, Toei Animation, and Shogakukan. Core capabilities include turnkey exhibition construction, interactive multimedia and AV integration, specialized lighting, custom millwork, kinetic installations, and low-voltage systems. Based in Taichung and Taipei; international delivery includes on-site installation in Madrid, Spain.
